notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250915
notes.notes:
Fixes an issue with unity particle effects causing crashes on some systems.
 Lowered the cost of Magic Mist from 50 AP to 40 AP.
 Fixed a particular save point on Chapter 8 not activating the "Save Menu" when pressing Interact.

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250912
notes.notes:
Swipe and X-Swipe now behave as expected when using Force of Nature.


 Turbo now persists across battle  level changes.


 Fixed an out of bounds when climbing a certain rope a certain way in Chapter 7.


 Fixed an occasional crash when Force of Nature was used with X-Fight. 

 Minor dialogue adjustments in Chapter 11 after completing certain side quests.

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250909
notes.notes:
Fixed visual bug where turn order list would not update correctly after swapping.

Fixed bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would silently and unexpectedly deal additional damage.

Fixed a bug where certain weapons for zikaron and agata would not proc ailments as often as expected.

Force of Nature no longer bypasses stun or sleep ailments.

Force of Nature CAN now be affected by "seconds".

Fix audio volume blip when quitting the game in certain ways.

Fixed various issues affecting battle actor positioning involving "seconds".

Increased drop rates for certain rare items on certain rare encounters.

Improved various NPC dialogue, Story screen triggers for improved clarity around endgame sidequests

Fixed a rare crash during a cutscene in ch.10 (and possibly in other rare scenarios).

Fixed a rare crash when changing scenes while a "camera hint" is present on-screen.

Adjustments to enemy balancing in the final dungeon, Jerome's side quest, and on hard mode.

Fixed logging errors when loading saves and on Windows/MacOS when accessing certain navigation functions in ch.11 (may fix some rare crashes).

Fixed typo for a specific location name on the ch.11 minimap.

Fixed some other minor dialogue/typos.

Fixed/improved some minor map issues.

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250905
notes.notes:
Fixed shop bug where selling items could cause the cursor to render incorrectly

Revised Trip Mine description for accuracy

Fixed a chapter 11 softlock when navigating a certain way south of Stral

Fixed an out of bounds in an endgame dungeon that allowed you to bypass the boss

Minor performance improvements when using the airship, certain UI operations, ending combat

Fixed a location appearing on the minimap before it had been discovered

Fixed a minor tiling issue in Cordelia's Chapter, Chapter 8

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.1.20250901.2
notes.notes:
Make turbo work outside of battle
 Buffs conferred by accessories can no longer be dispelled
 (Prologue) Le Dernier's moves now correctly scale off of magic
 (Prologue) Le Dernier's Mighty Guard now functions as expected
 Fixed a softlock in chapter 8 when triggering a certain pushback event from a certain direction
 Don't show "Chapter Select" or "Chapter 7" in a popup when choosing to save at the end of a chapter
 Fixed some missing visuals in the environment in chapter 8 
 Fixed a typo on a certain location name on the minimap

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.0.20250901
notes.notes:
Fixes two more softlocks when traversing the world map in certain ways in the final chapter.

Added a world map "recovery mode" accessible from the debug menu to help people get out of any similar softlocks in case we've missed any (please continue to report these!); tap on the version number on the config menu from the title screen to access the debug menu

Fixed a typo in the Config menu helptext for one of the options

Made the movement puzzle in Ben's chapter more forgiving, significantly more so when the "Casual" difficulty mode is enabled.

Fixed a missing out of bounds collision in the final dungeon

notes.title: Bugfix Update 1.0.20250831
notes.notes:
While we're still hard at work on the 1.1 feature update, this patch includes a few bugfixes we wanted to get to customers in 1.0, sooner.  This includes:



Fixes a softlock when performing certain world map traversal actions

Fixes a hang when fighting a certain enemy in Cordelia's chapter

Fixes a hang when providing unexpected input during a minigame in chapter 9

notes.title: QUARTET is NOW LIVE! Release trailer, Oxford commas, Patch 1.1 and more!
notes.notes:
Hello, y'all!



We're thrilled to announce that Quartet has officially launched and the response has been absolutely incredible! We're currently holding strong with a Metacritic score of 87, and we couldn't be more grateful for the amazing reception from players and critics alike.


Watch our Release Trailer: 

[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=x1dtKybfyaE"][/dynamiclink]

In a delightful turn of events, we even hit the front page of Reddit today for our most obscure configuration option: the Oxford Comma toggle!

Check out the viral thread here: 

https://www.reddit.com/r/gaming/comments/1n1vswb/in_my_42_years_i_have_never_seen_such_an_obscure

And give it some more love!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/c1a42746a3dafcb410bfb301d5d14f077c9a3c95.jpg"]



Zero-day Patch:

We have also shipped a new patch that is LIVE NOW:

Bug: Save Files were not transferring from Demo to Full Game when playing on the Steam Deck



Coming soon in Patch 1.1:

We were listening to the discourse on the Steam forums as well as the features folks are expecting. We're already hard at work on our first update, which will include:

Hard Difficulty Mode: For those seeking an even greater challenge (Part of version 1.1!)

Turbo Button for Battles: Speed through encounters at your own pace (Part of version 1.1!)

Streamer Mode: A mode for Streamers, point your streaming software "Image Sources" overlay to your save file and automatically update your front-row party display overlay for your stream (1.1 update!)

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/17f904887044864763c3f314871452a490a7b652.png"]



Support Ongoing Development

Your support directly fuels future updates and content! By purchasing Quartet now, you're helping us continue to enhance and expand the game with new features, quality-of-life improvements, and additional content down the road.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37740350/4e45c0456bcc63b6bc8c16fc3e5de3e148b62ca6.png"]



Thank you for being part of this incredible launch. The journey through the world of Quartet has only just begun!





Team Something Classic

notes.title: Demo Update: Fixed for EU Players!
notes.notes:
We've pushed an update to the demo containing some important bug fixes and other improvements.

Fixed a combat crash for French players.  This also fixes laggy sound effect issues for other EU countries.

Fixed an issue causing temporarily unresponsive inputs on the title screen.

Made some improvements to the opening sequence in Nikolai's chapter.

Fixed some issues with enemy attack animation placement.

Fixed application of defensive buffs during the prologue chapter.

notes.title: Quartet August Update Jamboree
notes.notes:
Hi all,

Just wanted to send all of you a quick update. We have no specific topic we wanted to talk about, or area I'd like to show, so we think it'd be a good opportunity to do a bit of grab bag of screenshots. (The new stuff we are working on is heavy spoiler-filled and we want to save that for you when you play the game!) Speaking of which, we have just started work on Chapter 10 of 11. That means after this chapter is completed all we have left is the final dungeon and all the side and backer content. We are getting very, very close to releasing the game!

So without further ado, let's look at a collection of shots ranging from the very beginning of the game up through and including Chapter 9. I'll present them without any commentary, so you can let your imagination fill in the blanks!

Ok! That's it. Let me know in the comments if you enjoyed this style of update. As always, we sincerely appreciate all your support. Making JRPGs is the dream of this team and because of your support, we are making the best one we possibly can. We cannot wait for you to try it!

If you want to stay in touch, please join us on our discord and follow us on twitter. Have a great day!

Team Something Classic
